purpose: The support lines a student sees when the safety assessment returns crisis or elevated (#465). One list, read three ways: frontend/src/lib/crisisContacts.ts holds the same values and its test compares them field by field; the two canned responses in safety_assessment_conformance.json must name every line here; and jbjgjf/BLESC-website's scripts/check-crisis-contacts.mjs fetches this file and compares it with SOS_DIAL in src/lib/trust.ts, because blesc.jp promises this exact dial by name and number.

verification.source: 文部科学省「24時間子供SOSダイヤル」の公式案内 https://www.mext.go.jp/ijime/detail/dial.htm
verification.note: The number matches docs/static_safety_school_support_reference.md and the site, but nobody has yet read it off the official page for this file. Whoever does fills in verified_on (YYYY-MM-DD) and verified_by, and sets status to verified. A changed number or hours means changing this file, crisisContacts.ts and both responses together.
